items.name: slat-shutter-hero
items.title: Slat Shutter Hero
items.description: A scroll-driven hero. The first photo is cut into vertical slats that part from the centre outwards to reveal a second full-bleed scene, while the two-line headline hands over line by line. Falls back to a still hero when reduced motion is on.

items.name: photo-deck
items.title: Photo Deck
items.description: A stack of photo prints you can drag, flick or step through with the arrows and keyboard. The top print flies off with a tilt, the previous one flies back in from the left, the counter rolls like an odometer and the caption hands over in sequence. Pass your own photos, titles and notes.

items.name: timeline-scrubber
items.title: Timeline Scrubber
items.description: Drag along a month ruler to move through a set of photos. Each image wipes in from the direction you move, the value (temperature in the demo) rolls on digit reels, and arrow, Home and End keys work too. Good for seasons, project stages or before and after stories.

items.name: testimonial-reel
items.title: Testimonial Reel
items.description: A testimonial block with a big quote, a portrait that slides up like a reel and a key stat that rolls like an odometer. Face thumbnails act as tabs with a progress line, autoplay pauses on hover and only runs while the block is on screen.

items.name: morph-island
items.title: Morph Island
items.description: A dynamic island style status pill that morphs between idle, uploading with a rolling percentage, done and a full photo preview. One state prop drives it, so it drops into any upload, export or background task flow. The demo plays the whole sequence when it scrolls into view.

items.name: facts-hero
items.title: Facts Hero
items.description: A dark hero with a light serif headline, two buttons and a large photo panel carrying a frosted "at a glance" card. Rows rise in one by one and the figures roll on digit reels when the hero comes into view. Built for firms and services that sell on credibility.

items.name: fan-gallery
items.title: Fan Gallery
items.description: Photo cards fanned on an arc that you can drag, flick, tap or step with arrows and keys. The fan sizes itself to the screen so every visible card fits with a gap, loops without a seam, autoplays and pauses on hover. The centre card's name and tags sit underneath.

items.name: feature-ui-row
items.title: Feature UI Row
items.description: A feature row pairing copy with a small live UI on a coloured panel. Comes with two visuals: a checklist that ticks itself off beside a rolling stat card, and a timeline bar that fills stage by stage. Flip the side with reverse and switch the panel tone.

items.name: bento-mini-ui
items.title: Bento Mini UI
items.description: A dark bento grid of four feature cards, each with its own small animated UI: chips that gather around a highlight, a person card, wrong options being struck out and a review list where a flag appears and then resolves. Each card plays when it scrolls into view.

items.name: torn-portrait-scroll
items.title: Torn Portrait Scroll
items.description: A sticky scroll section with a list on the left and a portrait collage in the middle. As you scroll, each point takes over: the photo wipes in on torn paper in a new colour, a caption card swaps its rows and the copy on the right hands over. Click any list item to jump to it.

items.name: scroll-fill-headline
items.title: Scroll Fill Headline
items.description: A two-line serif headline whose words fill from pale to ink as you scroll, with optional photo objects (a paper plane and a compass in the demo) drifting and turning past at their own speed. A quiet statement section between busier blocks.

items.name: sector-wheel
items.title: Sector Wheel
items.description: A vertical word wheel for industries, services or locations. The centre item is sharp and the neighbours blur and shrink away, a rolling counter and arrows sit beside it, and the note on the left changes with each item. Autoplays, pauses on hover and you can click any item.

items.name: scattered-about
items.title: Scattered About
items.description: An about section with the copy in the middle and six photos scattered around it in fixed slots, each drifting at its own speed as you scroll. On phones the photos become a tidy swipe strip under the copy.
